Tone sequences

During this experiment, you will hear different tone sequences. Listen carefully to each one. Pay attention to which sequences are common and which are rare.

COMMON
RARE

Play each sequence at least once, then press Continue.

Listen to both sequences. Which is the more common sequence?

Debrief

Thank you. This study tests whether hearing an unexpected sound changes the decisions people make. Most choices followed the common tone sequence, and some followed a rare one.
